findings.where: Title-block nav bar: the static 'DRAWING MMM-GA-001' and 'SCALE NTS' cells beside the PROFILE / ARTICLES / BLOG / CONTACT link cells. Worst on phone, where the two static cells share the top row with the logo, directly above a row of four nav cells boxed the same way
findings.fault: The links and the drawing-data labels sit in matching ruled cells of one bar, in the same light capitals, so the bar's cell look stands for two things: 'go somewhere' and 'a fixed label'. Nothing tells a visitor which cells are links. The drawing number and scale look like two more menu items, and tapping them does nothing (parts map: static).
findings.who_objects: A development-bank visitor looking through the menu for Mark's profile or contact details, who taps 'MMM-GA-001' or 'NTS' as a menu item, gets nothing, and has to work out which cells are real links. Angélique would hit the same question when she adds a page to the menu.

findings.where: Motion sketch panel: the 'REPLAY THE CUT' button
findings.fault: A button that acts on the page is dressed as a link: underlined spaced capitals, styled like the underlined article link 'Streamlining the PPP Process…'. Without the underline, the same capitals are also used for the static section labels (PALETTE, TEXTURE, TYPE PAIR). The underline belongs to links, so the button borrows it. A visitor expects it to go somewhere, but it replays the animation where they are.
findings.who_objects: Mark and the founder, reviewing the motion sketch, expect a link to open another page and may not try the replay. The layout round would also take this tile's signal that an underline can mean either a link or a button.

findings.where: Article specimen: the bordered attachment box holding 'Streamlining the PPP Process: Meeting the ‘Abundance’ Challenge' and 'Lecture • 2026-04-23 · PDF'
findings.fault: The whole box has its own edge and reads as one clickable attachment card, with 'PDF' as the cue to download. Only the underlined title is a link. The 'PDF' label and the rest of the box do nothing when clicked (parts map: only the title acts).
findings.who_objects: An article reader who goes for the 'PDF' label or the box to open the lecture gets no response, and has to find the title link instead.
